desc: Sheldon and Penny, both holding paper bags with groceries, turn to walk in opposite directions away from one another, in the hallway.
Out of fright, Penny drops a paper bag full of shopping, while standing next to the door of her apartment.
Sheldon, in a red shirt, was starring at a figurine as Stuart passes by.
Stuart grabs an Aquaman statue from shelf behind him.
Stuart takes out a Batman squirt gun from behind the counter.
Leonard, in a grey hoodie, is showing Penny pictures on his cell phone, while sitting on the couch.
Penny, in a purple floral shirt, opens her apartment door for a pizza delivery guy.
The pizza delivery man turns and looks at Sheldon with a plastic bag in his hand, while he walks away.
Sheldon puts his arms on his hips while facing a trash can, at the kitchen.
Bernadette sets a glass mixing bowl into a dish drainer tray.
Howard pulls a tube of cream out of his pocket and hands it to Bernadette.
Bernadette, in a pink sweater, reads the information on the bottle of cream.
Bernadette, in a pink sweater, sits down on the blue couch next to Howard.
Howard grabs a yellow pillow and hugs it for comfort, while sitting on the blue couch.
Amy picks up her blue coffee cup and walks out of the kitchen where Sheldon sits with yellow cup.
Amy and Sheldon put their ears up to the door.
Sheldon, in a red shirt, gets the key on his pocket and opens the door, while standing next to Amy.
A Leonard, in a grey hoodie, stands up scared as Sheldon and Amy enter the apartment.
Leonard, in a grey jacket, is sitting on the couch with his elbow on his knee next to Penny.
Raj, in a green and grey shirt, picks up a piece of cake from the coffee table and starts eating it.
Howard lifts up his shirt to show Raj his chest.
Howard jumps up and down with his shirt pulled up.
Raj, in a green and grey shirt, shakes his chest from side to side.
Howard sticks the bottom of his shirt up over his head.
Howard stands in front of the couch with his shirt pulled up and shimmies his torso.
Raj pulls his shirt over his head as he shakes his body in front of Howard.
Raj puts his hand on Howard's bare chest as Bernadette walks into the room.
Bernadette walks away after seeing Raj and Howard holding each others bare chests.
Leonard pours coffee from the coffee pot into a travel mug.
Sheldon, in a beige jacket,  holds the buildings door open while talking to someone.
Sheldon comes out of the apartment to where Amy and Penny, in a white shirt and yellow vest, are.
Raj, in a red sweater, sits on the floor while his friends are having a conversation at the living room table.
Sheldon gets a piece of paper from the side table and hands it to Penny, while they are eating at the living room table.
Penny, with two ponytails and in a turquoise floral top,  hands Howard the piece of paper she was holding.
